plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: Starter settings for Claude Code: setup lets each person opt in to turning off auto memory, dynamic workflows, session recap, prompt suggestions, idle compaction and the feedback survey in user-scope settings.json, to the ultra-concise output style this plugin ships, and to four guideline rule files (advisor, chat, coding, writing).

plugins.name: destructive
plugins.description: Skills that delete Claude Code state: purge-user-scope wipes ~/.claude and ~/.claude.json and keeps the claude binary; uninstall-cli also removes the binary, its installed versions and its shell rc entries.

plugins.name: claudecodemonitor-hud-mod
plugins.description: Mod: a band above the prompt with the session's model and effort beside the ones your settings set, the advisor model, and the git branch.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Skills that author this marketplace's own parts: create-skill writes skills, plugin files, marketplace entry and README rows to strict LLM-optimized rules.

plugins.name: provided-by-team
plugins.description: Skills written by XVE team members: robbe-review-skill reviews a PR or branch against its Jira ticket, business logic first, with an optional strict code check.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian's own plugin: the Atlassian MCP server for Jira and Confluence plus Atlassian's skills, pinned to the commit the Anthropic plugin directory reviewed.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry's own plugin: the Sentry MCP server plus Sentry's debugging skills, pinned to the commit the Anthropic plugin directory reviewed.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Plugins every XVE developer runs: installs the vendors' own Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) and Sentry plugins, MCP servers and skills, pinned to the commits the Anthropic plugin directory reviewed.
